artworks.title: Les Vieux
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows four individuals in a room. Two adults are near a wardrobe, one holding a door open. Two children are on the floor, one interacting with a small dog. The adults have upstyled hair and wear long dresses. The children are dressed in historical fashion. The wardrobe is ornately decorated, and there is a curtain in the background. The room has a checkered floor and exudes elegance.

artworks.title: Les Vieux
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with figures. The central part of the drawing depicts a detailed scene inside a room, with ornate furniture and decorations. There is a cabinet with intricately designed doors, and within the room, there is a sense of domestic activity. The floor is tiled, and a dog is present. Surrounding the main image are various sketches and doodles, including a pastoral scene at the top with a vast landscape and a person walking, while the sides and bottom have images of animals, flowers, and other figures. The style of drawing is highly detailed and reminiscent of a narrative engraving.

artworks.title: Une Vieux Chantier à Rochester
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and aquatint in brown ink on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image is an etching depicting a riverside industrial area with a possible dockyard in a horizontal layout. The upper third shows the horizon with windmills and building silhouettes in the distance. The intricate linear strokes create various elements, with denser strokes on the right side suggesting more activity. The left side has fewer linear elements with rounded forms possibly representing barrels or containers. The monochromatic color palette consists of sepia tones, giving the piece a rustic and aged appearance. The detailed structures and objects, along with a figure engaged in labor, provide a sense of scale to the setting.

artworks.title: Les Petites Chaumières
artworks.medium: drypoint and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a rural, thatched-roof cottage with a view from slightly above ground level. The horizon is visible around two-thirds up the image, with a line of structures and distant landforms. The brushstrokes are textured, featuring cross-hatching and linear marks for depth. The color palette is monochromatic, using dark and light grays and blacks for contrast. In the foreground, a flock of geese is visible in a grassy area, bordered by a wooden fence. Smoke rises from the cottage chimney. The background displays a cloudy sky created with soft strokes.

artworks.title: Les Grandes Chaumières
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on antique laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image depicts a rustic village scene featuring thatched-roof cottages, wooden fences, and a low horizon with rooftops and chimneys. The etching showcases detailed brushstrokes capturing various textures, with a monochromatic sepia color palette. A stone or wooden wall leads into the scene, alongside grassy vegetation. The cottages create a sense of enclosure, with trees and other structures in the background. A cart is placed near the wall.

artworks.title: La Chapelle Saint-Michel à l'Estre
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows an elevated view of a landscape with detailed line work in warm sepia tones. The horizon is located near the top, with a cluster of structures visible in the distance. Close to us, there is textured shrubbery, and the ground is marked with dots and lines. Rolling hills and flat areas lead towards the horizon, where the sky is depicted with horizontal lines and hatchings.

artworks.title: La Chapelle Saint-Michel à l'Estre (Second Version)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on antique laid paper, soaked in turpentine
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with rolling hills and undulating terrain. A small structure is visible on the horizon. The style features detailed lines and hatching to represent texture across the landscape. The color palette is primarily sepia or soft brown. Shrubs and bushes are depicted close by, with open spaces and distant hills in the background.

artworks.title: Arbres et Bateaux (Trees and Boats)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a sparse drawing of a landscape. A tree with elongated branches is on the left side, with a twist in its trunk. Near the horizon, there are several sailing boats on calm water. The composition suggests a vast openness and distance. The sketching is subtle and precise, focusing on gentle contouring and minimal detail. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by a muted brown tone. The overall impact is serene and understated, inviting the viewer to focus on the hints of narrative within the scene.

artworks.title: J.Barbey d'Aurevilly
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint printed in red on thin japan paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched portrait of a man facing forward. He has a handlebar mustache and curly hair, wearing a dark garment visible up to the shoulders. The background is plain and light-colored with specks and marks scattered across it.

artworks.title: Les Anes de Saint-Medard
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Daniel Bell and Pearl K. Bell
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a city in the distance. The horizon line is positioned just below the center of the image and features buildings with a tall spire. There are figures and animals in the foreground, one of which appears to be a woman with a donkey. The sky has swirling clouds with linear hatch marks. The color palette is mainly shades of grey and black on an off-white backdrop, giving an aged look to the scene.

artworks.title: Gorge de Royat, Auvergne
artworks.medium: lithograph on chine collé
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape from an elevated point of view. The horizon is in the upper third, showcasing softly rolling hills and distant mountains. There are a cluster of buildings beyond some large trees on the right side, among scattered logs. The buildings are surrounded by a wooded landscape. The art style features detailed lines and various textures, emphasizing the tree bark and stonework. The color scheme mainly includes black, white, and gray tones. The composition balances rustic foreground elements with the serene background view.

artworks.title: Clair de lune à Valmondois (Moonlight at Valmondois)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural landscape under a moonlit sky. The horizon is low in the composition, with haystacks and trees silhouetted against it. The moon is partially hidden by clouds, casting light across the scene. The etching technique used creates texture and movement. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of black and white. A figure tends to cattle in the forefront, with more foliage in the distance.

artworks.title: Evening Light on a Wooded Lakeside with Cattle Drinking
artworks.medium: watercolor with touches of white gouache over traces of charcoal on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Andrea Woodner
artworks.description: This painting shows a landscape. The horizon is low in the composition, obscured by trees and distant hills. Large trees with dark green foliage surround a reflective body of water at the bottom of the painting. Near the center, two cows drink from the water, and a person stands nearby, almost blending in with the foliage. The brushstrokes are fluid and colors blend softly. The color palette includes earthy greens, browns, pale blues, and pinks in the sky and reflected in the water.

artworks.title: Edge of a Wood
artworks.medium: black and white chalk on buff laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of trees viewed from the ground up, with branches stretching into the sky. The horizon is obscured by the trees, creating a natural separation between the earth and sky. The artwork is sketched using textured brushstrokes, likely charcoal, creating a sense of depth in the tree foliage. The color scheme is muted, with mostly gray and black tones complemented by a tan background. This contrast highlights the tree details and provides a serene visual impact. Delicate shading and blending enhance the light and shadow transitions, adding depth.

artworks.title: A Rocky Meadow by a River
artworks.medium: black chalk with white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The perspective offers a broad view of the serene scene. A line of trees marks the high horizon. The pencil sketch captures the undulating terrain and foliage with flowing strokes. The color palette is muted. The drawing depicts grass, rocks, and a small body of water in the foreground. In the distance, large trees and vegetation extend towards the horizon, creating a sense of tranquility and space.

artworks.title: Oaks in the Vaux de Cernay
artworks.medium: etching on chine collé (proof)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a winding dirt path, large trees on the right, a slope with shrubs and an oxen-driven cart on the left. The sky is filled with light clouds, and in the distance, there are foliage and faint structures, possibly a church spire. The artwork is monochromatic, using shades of gray and detailed line work.

artworks.title: Interior of a Forge (recto) / Yard with a Pigsty (verso)
artworks.medium: charcoal on blue laid paper; verso, graphite and black and white chalk on blue laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Helen Porter and James T. Dyke
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched interior scene with large, undefined shapes creating an enclosed space, possibly furniture or structural elements. The color palette consists of various shades of gray, with charcoal pencil markings on grayish paper. The arched form is in the center-right area surrounded by other shapes on the left and right sides, creating a sense of depth and layered space.

artworks.title: The Grieving Virgin Contemplating Instruments of the Passion
artworks.medium: black chalk with stumping and gray wash on laid paper with a second piece added to the bottom
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated from the waist up, leaning slightly forward with clasped hands at chest level. They have a serene expression, with eyes gently closed or half-closed. The individual wears a head covering and flowing garment that covers the upper body and knees. Soft fabric drapes extend over the shoulders. The background is softly rendered and neutral, creating a tranquil atmosphere.

artworks.title: Apollo and Marsyas
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of several figures in a mythological or historical scene. The central figure is a muscular, nude male with a cloak over one shoulder, holding a knife and a draped skin. Other figures surround him, some in distressed poses. One figure hangs upside-down from a tree. The characters are dressed in armor and classical attire, showing a historical or mythological context. The drawing features intricate line work, highlighting textures of skin, fabric, and foliage, with a landscape in the background.

artworks.title: Alpine Castle above a Wooded Lake
artworks.medium: charcoal with stumping,scraping, erasing and wetting, and white chalk on beige laid paper, laid down
artworks.creditLine: Helen Porter and James T. Dyke Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a dense, wooded area with a castle on a hill in the distance. The horizon is low, with the castle towers marking it. The painting has textured brushstrokes depicting trees and rocks. The color palette is mostly sepia tones, with shades of brown and hints of gray. Tall trees frame the scene, and a mountain range rises behind the castle in the misty sky.

artworks.title: Countryside near Brezins, between Grenoble and Vienne
artworks.medium: black chalk and watercolor on two joined sheets of wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a high horizon marked by rolling hills, some trees, a winding path with wooden fence posts, and small structures. Brushstrokes are loose and fluid, and the color palette includes earth tones, greens, blues, and whites.

artworks.title: A Village near Brezins
artworks.medium: black chalk and watercolor on two joined sheets of wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Joan and David Maxwell
artworks.description: The image features a rural scene split into two sections. On the left side is a charcoal sketch of houses and trees drawn with quick strokes, creating depth. On the right side, the same scene is painted in watercolors with earthy tones for the houses and trees, and a light blue sky. The sky in the watercolor section contains two small figures. The contrast between the charcoal sketch and watercolor emphasizes the artist's exploration of light and texture through different techniques.

artworks.title: Chute de la Tritt dans la vallée de Muhlethal
artworks.medium: color etching and wash-manner engraving on laid paper [proof]
artworks.creditLine: Phillips Family Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a bridge crossing a waterfall with workers on it. There is no horizon shown. The focus is on the waterfall and the bridge. The brushstrokes are smooth, depicting the water and rocks. Earth tones dominate, with splashes of blue and white in the water and sky, and a rainbow in the mist. A figure in a cloak sits on the rocks in the foreground.

artworks.title: Standing Woman
artworks.medium: graphite on buff wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ruth Cole Kainen
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a person from mid-thigh upwards. The person's torso is slightly turned, with some facial features like lips and a facial outline. The person has short, wavy hair. The clothing is represented by circular patterns and lines, possibly indicating a wrap or drape. No jewelry or objects are visible in the sketch. The background is plain, light beige paper.
